title: Spinach tortilla egg muffins + carrots + raspberries
summary: Ingredients: • 4 eggs • ½ cup cottage cheese • ¼ cup cheddar cheese • Handful spinach • 1 large tortilla Directions: Blend everything except tortilla. Cut tortilla into muffin cups.
caption: Day 2 of 20 toddler lunch ideas 🤍 Spinach tortilla egg muffins + carrots + raspberries 💛 Ingredients: • 4 eggs • ½ cup cottage cheese • ¼ cup cheddar cheese • Handful spinach • 1 large tortilla Directions: Blend everything except tortilla. Cut tortilla into muffin cups. Pour mixture on top.
